prompt.es: Responde al mensaje de Kenji: explica los dos modismos en inglés sencillo.

answer.text: Hi Kenji, sorry about that. Those are idioms. “Back to square one” means we have to start again from the beginning. We made a plan, but it did not work, so we are at the start again. “Hit the nail on the head” means to say exactly the right thing. When Leo said the price was too high, he hit the nail on the head, because it was exactly the problem. In other words, the first idiom is about starting again and the second is about being exactly right. Does that make sense? I can also write without idioms next time. Thank you for asking!
